commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'os='; cat /etc/alpine-release
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'openssl='; command -v openssl || true
printf 'update_ca_certificates='; command -v update-ca-certificates || true
printf 'candidate_cert='; if [ -e /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt ]; then echo present; else echo absent; fi
printf 'candidate_key='; if [ -e /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key ]; then echo present; else echo absent; fi

set -eu
apk add --no-cache openssl ca-certificates
openssl version
update-ca-certificates --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
printf 'trust_tool=%s\n' "$(command -v update-ca-certificates)"

commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0700 /etc/ssl/private
install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates
umask 077
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:3072 -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes -keyout /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' -addext 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid:always'
chmod 0600 /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 0644 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
update-ca-certificates
printf 'created=%s\n' /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

set -eu
cert=/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
key=/etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'certificate_metadata:\n'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates -fingerprint -sha256
printf 'basic_constraints:\n'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -ext basicConstraints
printf 'key_usage:\n'
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -ext keyUsage
cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -in "$cert" -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER 2>/dev/null | openssl dgst -sha256)
key_pub=$(openssl pkey -in "$key" -pubout -outform DER 2>/dev/null | openssl dgst -sha256)
[ "$cert_pub" = "$key_pub" ]
printf 'private_key_matches_certificate=yes\n'
printf 'permissions cert=%s key=%s\n' "$(stat -c '%a' "$cert")" "$(stat -c '%a' "$key")"
printf 'default_system_trust='; openssl verify "$cert"
printf 'explicit_system_bundle_trust='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/cert.pem "$cert"
cert_hash=$(openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -hash)
printf 'system_hash_link='; ls -l "/etc/ssl/certs/$cert_hash.0"
printf 'apk_packages='; apk info -e openssl ca-certificates | tr '\n' ' '; printf '\n'
